jobs.promptSummary: Remove only the small cream/yellow wooden rowboat and its pale reflection. Reconstruct the green-blue lake and vertical pine-tree reflections. Keep the dock, forest, shoreline, colors, perspective and exact 2:1 framing unchanged. No new objects or text. Opaque repair crop.
jobs.integration: Only the 105×62 source-pixel hull/reflection region is composited, with an eight-pixel feather; all other source pixels are retained.

jobs.promptSummary: Extract only the same empty cream/ivory wooden rowboat with gold rim, reddish brown interior and cross seats, at the same wide side/three-quarter angle. Preserve orientation and cel-shaded daylight style. Genuine transparent background, no water, reflection, dock, people, oars, props, redesign or text.
jobs.integration: Alpha-trimmed and resized to a 256-pixel texture, rendered at approximately the original boat size; reflection is a separate mirrored layer.
